name: token-budget-monorepo
description: Monorepo for token-budget core and its adapter/tokenizer packages.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=token-budget --workspace=token-budget-tiktoken && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=token-budget --workspace=token-budget-tiktoken && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
